pieces.name: middle

pieces.name: center

pieces.name: east_wing
pieces.notes: east wing, ridge N-S near x~700, dark north hip triangle, bright east face

notes: Long grey shingle ranch, trees cover the south eave. Trace overshoots badly: trees and ground to the west, the whole yard and neighbour 7774's roof to the south, ground to the NE. Confidence medium: wing boundaries high, ridge detail inside west_wing and middle low (bright faces form an X, could be one pyramid).
